annotation.title_clean: Ley Nº 30740, Ley que regula el uso y las operaciones de los sistemas de aeronaves pilotadas a distancia (RPAS)
annotation.title_en: Law No. 30740, Law regulating the use and operations of remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República del Perú
named_instruments_referenced: Ley 27261 Ley de Aeronáutica Civil del Perú
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian Law 30740 regulates civil use of remotely piloted aircraft systems (drones) under Article 8 of the Chicago Convention. It sets DGAC licensing, a public registry, no-fly conditions (urban areas, protected zones, privacy violations), sanctions, test zones, and tax benefits for R&D; it excludes state military/police and small recreational drones.
key_provisions_or_claims: Civil RPAS operations other than recreational require an operator/pilot licence from MTC-DGAC.
Mandatory public registry of RPAs and owners, with fines for non-registration.
Operations not authorised if they endanger manned aviation, overfly urban/protected/restricted areas, or violate privacy.
Excludes state military, police, customs drones and recreational drones under 2 kg.
Regulation to set geographic test zones; R&D spending eligible for Law 30309 tax benefits.
